items.title: How Much Feedback Is Needed to Break Template Protection? The Geometric Vulnerability of Biometric Authentication
items.title_zh: 需要多少反馈才能破坏模板保护？生物特征认证的几何漏洞
items.description:
Biometric authentication systems increasingly use privacy-preserving mechanisms to protect sensitive templates. However, the authentication interface itself may still leak information that enables reconstruction attacks. Prior attacks exploit released similarity scores, whereas more advanced systems reveal only the binary accept/reject decision. This binary feedback provides substantially less information, making template reconstruction far more challenging.
  In this work, we introduce query-efficient reconstruction attacks under extremely limited feedback, addressing two key limitations of prior attacks. First, we introduce the first attack that reconstructs protected biometric templates using only authentication success/failure feedback by exploiting the geometric constraints of biometric authentication. Second, we introduce distribution-aware query-efficient reconstruction methods for score-releasing systems, achieving a more realistic threat model by reducing the number of required queries by a factor of 5times compared to recent prior score-based attacks. Finally, we combine these two insights by incorporating a pretrained facial diffusion prior into our geometric binary attack, reducing the number of required queries by a factor of 5times.
  Our findings reveal a fundamental security limitation of biometric authentication: independently of the template protection mechanism, the authentication process itself exposes geometric information that can enable perfect template reconstruction up to numerical precision. Moreover, the distribution of biometric templates can be leveraged to make significantly more effective reconstruction attacks.
items.description_zh:
生物特征认证系统越来越多地使用隐私保护机制来保护敏感模板。然而，身份验证接口本身仍然可能泄漏导致重建攻击的信息。先前的攻击利用已发布的相似性分数，而更先进的系统仅揭示二元接受/拒绝决策。这种二进制反馈提供的信息少得多，使得模板重建更具挑战性。
  在这项工作中，我们在极其有限的反馈下引入了查询有效的重建攻击，解决了先前攻击的两个关键限制。首先，我们介绍第一种攻击，通过利用生物特征认证的几何约束，仅使用身份验证成功/失败反馈来重建受保护的生物特征模板。其次，我们为分数发布系统引入了分布式感知查询高效重建方法，与最近基于分数的攻击相比，通过将所需查询数量减少了 5 倍，实现了更真实的威胁模型。最后，我们将这两种见解结合起来，将预先训练的面部扩散融入到我们的几何二进制攻击中，将所需查询的数量减少了 5 倍。
  我们的研究结果揭示了生物识别身份验证的基本安全限制：独立于模板保护机制，身份验证过程本身会暴露几何信息，这些信息可以实现完美的模板重建，达到数值精度。此外，可以利用生物识别模板的分布来进行更有效的重建攻击。
items.authors: Eliron Rahimi, Margarita Osadchy, Orr Dunkelman

items.title: Kolab: Benchmarking Human-Agent Collaboration in Long-Horizon Workflows
items.title_zh: Kolab：长期工作流程中的人机协作基准测试
items.description: When humans collaborate with AI agents on long-horizon tasks, what happens to the agents' contributions? For solving long-horizon tasks, humans place greater importance on ongoing interaction with AI agents (e.g., revising plans) than on an agent's ability to complete the task in a single attempt. However, most agentic benchmarks have focused more on automation. Strong performance on such benchmarks does not imply effective real-world collaboration. Professional workflows offer a useful setting, as they often involve interdependent steps. To address this gap, we introduce Kolab, a new dataset of 115+ hours of screen recordings of 50 professionals from 40 occupations collaborating with agents on realistic, long-horizon problems. Kolab also contains participants' collaboration and output quality judgments. Our analysis reveals diverse collaboration patterns, highlighting the importance of when and how professionals coordinate with agents. A collaborative agent must do two things that automation benchmarks never test: anticipate whether experts will adopt, modify, or reject its contribution once it leaves the chat window to guide its next steps, and assess collaboration quality from the unfolding workflow without constant expert feedback. Our benchmark operationalizes both: (1) forecasting how professionals use agent contributions at diverse workflows, and (2) verifying their judgments of collaboration satisfaction and output quality. Findings show that frontier models, both agentic and non-agentic, overestimate collaboration with experts and struggle to distinguish between high- and low-quality collaboration. Longer workflow context does not consistently improve these predictions. As frontier agents cannot yet understand long-horizon collaboration with experts, we position Kolab as a valuable dataset for studying human-agent collaboration grounded in real professional workflows.
items.description_zh: 当人类与人工智能代理协作执行长期任务时，代理的贡献会发生什么？为了解决长期任务，人类更重视与人工智能代理的持续交互（例如修改计划），而不是代理在一次尝试中完成任务的能力。然而，大多数代理基准测试更多地关注自动化。在此类基准测试中的出色表现并不意味着现实世界中的有效协作。专业的工作流程提供了有用的设置，因为它们通常涉及相互依赖的步骤。为了解决这一差距，我们引入了 Kolab，这是一个新的数据集，包含来自 40 个职业的 50 名专业人士与代理合作解决现实的长期问题的 115 多个小时的屏幕记录。 Kolab 还包含参与者的协作和输出质量判断。我们的分析揭示了不同的协作模式，强调了专业人员何时以及如何与座席协调的重要性。协作代理必须做自动化基准测试从未测试过的两件事：预测专家在离开聊天窗口后是否会采用、修改或拒绝其贡献以指导下一步，以及在没有持续专家反馈的情况下从展开的工作流程中评估协作质量。我们的基准可操作性：(1) 预测专业人员如何在不同的工作流程中使用代理贡献，以及 (2) 验证他们对协作满意度和输出质量的判断。研究结果表明，前沿模型，无论是代理还是非代理，都高估了与专家的合作，并且很难区分高质量和低质量的合作。较长的工作流程上下文并不能持续改善这些预测。由于前沿代理尚无法理解与专家的长期协作，因此我们将 Kolab 定位为一个有价值的数据集，用于研究���于真实专业工作流程的人机协作。
items.authors: Shirley Anugrah Hayati, Patricia Anugrah Setiani, Ruizi Wang, Zhouyi Li, Khanh Chi Le, Young-Jun Lee, Dongyeop Kang

items.title: Predictive Closure: A Set-Level Characterization of JEPA's Feature Selection
items.title_zh: 预测收敛：JEPA 特征选择的集合级表征
items.description: In joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPA), an encoder and a predictor are trained together to produce a representation that minimizes the error in predicting the representation of the next observation. Because the representations of both the current and the next observation are learned, it is unclear which features they will include. Earlier characterizations describe the features JEPA selects in terms of their individual predictability, raising the concern that unpredictable features, like a traffic light, will not be encoded into the representation. However, the prediction error is also affected by the relationships between features, e.g., the light's color helps predict whether the traffic will stop. We propose the predictive closure characterization, which accounts for these relationships. Based on a reformulation of the JEPA training objective, we show that selection depends on properties of feature sets. This view agrees with earlier works when features evolve independently, but makes new predictions when they do not, for instance that a feature like the traffic light can still be retained. We test this characterization in controlled experiments, which show that unpredictable features can become better represented when they help predict other features, and that changing one feature's predictive relationships can affect how well others are represented. We also demonstrate implications for steering feature selection: targeting one feature with an auxiliary objective, or supplying it to the predictor as side information, can strengthen the representation of another feature whose future values it helps predict, so steering can be indirect.
items.description_zh: 在联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）中，编码器和预测器一起训练，以生成一种表示，最大限度地减少预测下一个观察表示的误差。由于当前和下一个观察的表示都是学习的，因此不清楚它们将包含哪些特征。早期的特征描述了 JEPA 根据其个体可预测性选择的特征，引起了人们的担忧，即不可预测的特征（如交通灯）不会被编码到表示中。然而，预测误差也受到特征之间关系的影响，例如，灯光的颜色有助于预测交通是否会停止。我们提出了预测闭合特征，它解释了这些关系。基于 JEPA 训练目标的重新制定，我们表明选择取决于特征集的属性。当特征独立进化时，这种观点与早期的工作一致，但当特征不独立进化时，就会做出新的预测，例如仍然可以保留像交通灯这样的特征。我们在受控实验中测试了这种表征，结果表明，当不可预测的特征有助于预测其他特征时，它们可以得到更好的表示，并且改变一个特征的预测关系可以影响其他特征的表示程度。我们还展示了转向特征选择的含义：以辅助目标为目标的一个特征，或将其作为辅助信息提供给预测器，可以加强另一个特征的表示，该特征有助于预测其未来值，因此转向可以是间接的。
items.authors: Mosh Levy, Aly Lidayan, Yoav Goldberg

items.title: Judging the Justification: Decision Certificate Supervision for Generative Reward Models
items.title_zh: 判断合理性：生成奖励模型的决策证书监督
items.description: Generative reward models (GenRMs) generate natural language rationales to justify preference judgments, yet a correct verdict does not guarantee a sound justification. Existing approaches often rely on reference explanations to supervise rationales, but obtaining such references can be costly and does not necessarily establish whether generated rationales support the resulting verdict. To address these limitations, we propose DeCert, a framework that evaluates the validity and verdict consistency of generated rationales without requiring reference explanations. Crucially, DeCert translates these assessments into preference supervision that accounts for both verdict correctness and justification quality. In particular, when multiple sampled judgments share the same correct verdict, differences in certificate quality enable DeCert to construct rationale preference pairs that distinguish stronger from weaker justifications. Extensive empirical studies across two model families and multiple in- and out-of-distribution benchmarks demonstrate that DeCert consistently outperforms strong generative judge baselines while improving rationale quality. Moreover, DeCert effectively mitigates positional bias, improving position-consistent accuracy by up to 14.8 points. These results highlight the importance of supervising not only which verdict is correct, but also how that verdict is justified.
items.description_zh: 生成奖励模型（GenRM）生成自然语言原理来证明偏好判断的合理性，但正确的判决并不能保证合理的理由。现有的方法通常依赖参考解释来监督基本原理，但获得此类参考的成本可能很高，并且不一定能确定生成的基本原理是否支持最终的判决。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了 DeCert，一个无需参考解释即可评估生成理由的有效性和判决一致性的框架。至关重要的是，DeCert 将这些评估转化为偏好监督，既考虑了判决的正确性，又考虑了论证的质量。特别是，当多个抽样判断共享相同的正确判断时，证书质量的差异使 DeCert 能够构建区分较强和较弱理由的理由偏好对。对两个模型系列和多个分布内和分布外基准的广泛实证研究表明，DeCert 始终优于强大的生成判断基线，同时提高了基本原理质量。此外，DeCert 有效减轻了位置偏差，将位置一致精度提高了高达 14.8 个百分点。这些结果凸显了不仅监督哪个判决是正确的，而且还监督该判决如何合理的重要性。
items.authors: Guiquan Sun, Bing Bai, Martin Renqiang Min, Dongjin Song

items.title: On the Token Collapse Phenomenon in Textual Graph Soft Prompting
items.title_zh: 论文本图软提示中的Token崩溃现象
items.description: Recent methods for injecting graph structure into LLM prompts include graph soft prompting, in which a graph neural network (GNN) learns graph-specific tokens that capture relational information among entities in textual prompts. G-Retriever combines graph soft prompts with a verbalized description of the same graph to strengthen the textual prompt signal. We conduct an in-depth analysis of G-Retriever and uncover a pathological behavior we term token collapse. Across three benchmarks, three graph encoders, two LLM families, and both frozen and LoRA-adapted models, G-Retriever's graph tokens become almost indistinguishable across inputs. We provide evidence that the same failure is inherited by subsequent methods, even with multi-token pooling. Under the standard setup, swapping a token with the dataset mean, a token from another example, or one derived from a corrupted graph produces no resolved answer-level effect in accuracy. Moreover, a learned constant prompt that never accesses the graph matches or surpasses G-Retriever on all three benchmarks. These findings indicate that, rather than conveying graph content as intended, the collapsed token functions primarily as a generic soft prompt. We also examine conditions linked to this collapse and propose a two-stage procedure that yields non-collapsed tokens while maintaining competitive performance in most cases. However, token variability alone does not prove that the model uses graph information: via interventions and decoding probes, we show that depending on the configuration, a token can reflect the question, an answer prior, or graph-derived content that the LLM may or may not use. Overall, our results offer a practical approach to evaluating graph-token alignment rather than inferring it from task accuracy alone. Code to reproduce our experiments is available at https://github.com/difra100/Token_Collapse_KGQA.
items.description_zh: 最近将图结构注入 LLM 提示的方法包括图软提示，其中图神经网络 (GNN) 学习特定于图的标记，这些标记捕获文本提示中实体之间的关系信息。 G-Retriever 将图形软提示与同一图形的语言描述相结合，以强化文字提示信号。我们对 G-Retriever 进行了深入分析，发现了一种我们称之为代币崩溃的病态行为。在三个基准测试、三个图形编码器、两个 LLM 系列以及冻结模型和 LoRA 适应模型中，G-Retriever 的图形标记在输入之间几乎无法区分。我们提供的证据表明，即使使用多令牌池，后续方法也会继承相同的失败。在标准设置下，将标记与数据集均值、来自另一个示例的标记或从损坏的图表派生的标记交换不会在准确性方面产生解决的答案级别效果。此外，从不访问图形的学习持续提示在所有三个基准测试中都匹配或超过了 G-Retriever。这些发现表明，折叠的标记主要用作通用软提示，而不是按预期传达图形内容。我们还检查了与这种崩溃相关的条件，并提出了一个两阶段的程序，该程序可以产生非崩溃的代币，同时在大多数情况下保持竞争性能。然而，仅令牌可变性并不能证明模型使用图形信息：通过干预和解码探针，我们表明，根据配置，令牌可以反映问题、先验答案或LLM可能会或可能不会使用的图形派生内容。总的来说，我们的结果提供了一种评估图标记对齐的实用方法，而不是仅从任务准确性来推断。重现我们实验的代码可在 https://github.com/difra100/Token_Collapse_KGQA 获取。
items.authors: Andrea Giuseppe Di Francesco, Rishabh Jain, Franco Maria Nardini, Nicola Tonellotto, Pietro Liò, Fabrizio Silvestri

items.title: FLORA: An Open Model Suite for Scaling Robotics Data Engines
items.title_zh: FLORA：用于扩展机器人数据引擎的开放模型套件
items.description: The life-cycle of robotics foundation models crucially depends on data labels. Outcome reward labels are needed for monitoring real-world deployments. Process reward labels are needed during RL post-training. Timestamped captions are needed for filtering and balancing pretraining data. We present Flora, an industrial-quality data engine used for training GR00T models, that simultaneously covers these capabilities. Flora achieves SOTA scores on the captioning benchmark WGO-Bench and reward benchmarks RoboReward and Robometer. On internal benchmarks it is competitive with GPT-6 Astra while beating other frontier models. The model is substantially cheaper than API-based alternatives, roughly 125 times cheaper than GPT-6 Astra. Florais battle tested at scale, labeling 200,000 hours of data per day across 512 GB300s. By open-sourcing our data engine, we enable researchers to scale custom robotics datasets and explore emerging applications such as physical auto-research and human-to-robot transfer.
items.description_zh: 机器人基础模型的生命周期很大程度上取决于数据标签。需要结果奖励标签来监控现实世界的部署。强化学习后期训练期间需要过程奖励标签。过滤和平衡预训练数据需要带时间戳的标题。我们推出了 Flora，这是一种用于训练 GR00T 模型的工业质量数据引擎，它同时涵盖了这些功能。 Flora 在字幕基准 WGO-Bench 以及奖励基准 RoboReward 和 Robometer 上取得了 SOTA 分数。在内部基准测试中，它与 GPT-6 Astra 具有竞争力，同时击败了其他前沿型号。该模型比基于 API 的替代方案便宜得多，大约比 GPT-6 Astra 便宜 125 倍。 Florais 进行了大规模测试，每天在 512 GB300 上标记 200,000 小时的数据。通过开源我们的数据引擎，我们使研究人员能够扩展自定义机器人数据集并探索新兴应用，例如物理自动研究和人机转移。
items.authors: Sicong Leng, Yunze Man, Zhiqi Li, Jing Wang, Yuhe Zhang, Ryan Punamiya, Siddharth Patki, Kaiyuan Zheng, Zi-ang Cao, Zhiding Yu, Sifei Liu, Danfei Xu, Ben Levin, Jan Kautz, Yuke Zhu, Johan Bjorck, Linxi "Jim" Fan

items.title: KANLab: TensorFlow Playground for Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
items.description: KANLab is a browser-based visualization tool designed to interactively teach the core concepts of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN), forked from the widely successful TensorFlow Playground. To maximize educational clarity, KANLab omits residual connections and learnable scaling parameters found in modern KAN implementations, ensuring that displayed B-spline activation curves directly correspond to their underlying trainable control points. Users can inspect and modify activation functions, initialization schemes and observe gradient descent correcting manual disruptions. Furthermore, user can explore phenomena such as activation variance, interactive pruning, and re\-/training within a compact 2D machine learning setting. KANLab is open-source and available at https://kanlab.app/
items.description_zh: KANLab 是一款基于浏览器的可视化工具，旨在以交互方式教授 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络 (KAN) 的核心概念，该网络源自广泛成功的 TensorFlow Playground。为了最大限度地提高教育清晰度，KANLab 省略了现代 KAN 实现中的残差连接和可学习的缩放参数，确保显示的 B 样条激活曲线直接对应于其底层的可训练控制点。用户可以检查和修改激活函数、初始化方案并观察梯度下降纠正手动干扰。此外，用户可以在紧凑的 2D 机器学习设置中探索激活方差、交互式修剪和重新/训练等现象。 KANLab 是开源的，可从 https://kanlab.app/ 获取
items.authors: Lukas Niehaus, Robin Rawiel, Ulf Krumnack

items.title: LLM2Cert: LLM Synthesis of Certificates with SMT/Lean Verification
items.title_zh: LLM2Cert：带有 SMT/精益验证的 LLM 证书综合
items.description: Lyapunov functions and barrier certificates give state-space guarantees of stability and safety, but synthesizing and verifying them---especially for nonlinear, high-dimensional systems---remains an open challenge. Existing pipelines verify candidates with numerical solvers (sum-of-squares programs), interval methods, or satisfiability-modulo-theories (SMT) solvers, which often require relaxations, are conservative, or scale poorly with model dimension and nonlinearity. These limitations have also shaped benchmark design: standard test suites are dominated by low-dimensional polynomial systems chosen to suit what solvers can handle rather than what engineering applications require. We address both sides of this challenge. First, we introduce DynaCertBench, a benchmark of 105 instances: 80 non-redundant systems curated from the literature, extended with high-dimensional and control-constrained variants and new nonlinearly coupled systems, comprehensively spanning stability, region-of-attraction, forward-invariance, and safety tasks. Second, we present LLM2Cert, an LLM-driven framework that synthesizes candidate certificates and verifies them against their proof obligations: each obligation is routed to an SMT solver or directly to the Lean Proof-Repair agent. On DynaCertBench, LLM2Cert verifies 81 of 105 instances (77.1%), a 17.1 percentage point improvement over one-shot proposal without feedback. On the 81 fixed certificates, LLM2Cert verifies 22 that All-SMT leaves unresolved. Code and data are available at https://github.com/FormalCert-AI/llm2cert.
items.description_zh: 李雅普诺夫函数和势垒证书提供了稳定性和安全性的状态空间保证，但综合和验证它们（尤其是对于非线性、高维系统）仍然是一个开放的挑战。现有的流程使用数值解算器（平方和程序）、区间方法或可满足性模理论 (SMT) 解算器来验证候选解算器，这些解算器通常需要松弛、保守，或者模型维度和非线性的扩展性较差。这些限制也影响了基准设计：标准测试套件以低维多项式系统为主，这些系统选择适合求解器可以处理的内容，而不是工程应用程序所需的内容。我们应对这一挑战的两个方面。首先，我们介绍 DynaCertBench，这是一个包含 105 个实例的基准：从文献中挑选的 80 个非冗余系统，通过高维和控制约束变体以及新的非线性耦合系统进行扩展，全面涵盖稳定性、吸引区域、前向不变性和安全任务。其次，我们提出了 LLM2Cert，这是一个 LLM 驱动的框架，用于合成候选证书并根据其证明义务验证它们：每个义务都被路由到 SMT 求解器或直接路由到精益证明修复代理。�� DynaCertBench 上，LLM2Cert 验证了 105 个实例中的 81 个实例 (77.1%)，比没有反馈的一次性提案提高了 17.1 个百分点。在 81 个固定证书上，LLM2Cert 验证了 All-SMT 未解决的 22 个证书。代码和数据可在 https://github.com/FormalCert-AI/llm2cert 获取。
items.authors: Zhipeng Cao, Peiyang Song, Nikolaus Vertovec, Weiru Cui, Zhihao Yang, Mingkang Liu, Luxia Lin, Bai Xue, Alessandro Abate

items.title: JockeyBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Horse-Racing Decision-Making
items.title_zh: JockeyBench：评估LLM代理人的赛马决策
items.description: Repeated event forecasting requires extracting predictive signals from noisy evidence and evaluating their value across successive decisions. We introduce JockeyBench, a benchmark and evaluation protocol that studies this problem through historical Japanese horse racing. The protocol combines time-gated evidence, priced tools, paired frozen-program controls, and two workflows: executing an LLM-written predictor or acquiring evidence for a fresh per-race LLM forecast. Evaluation separates forecast quality, benchmark-specific net utility, and retrospective betting returns and risk under fixed decision rules. Across 28 model--scaffold configurations on 324 races, paired tests identify seven revision gains and two declines after multiple-testing correction. Yet every configuration has negative mean profit under capped-Kelly settlement. In a four-model comparison, the reusable-program workflow has higher mean betting profit and lower research fees, although both workflows lose on average. Further diagnostics reveal that mean probability bias reverses on selected bets and that profitable individual runs can depend on concentrated returns. These findings motivate evaluating predictive competence, adaptation, resource use, and decision value separately when assessing agents for repeated event forecasting.
items.description_zh: 重复事件预测需要从嘈杂的证据中提取预测信号，并在连续的决策中评估它们的价值。我们引入 JockeyBench，这是一个基准和评估协议，通过历史上的日本赛马研究这个问题。该协议结合了时间门控证据、定价工具、配对冻结程序控制和两个工作流程：执行 LLM 编写的预测器或获取新的每场 LLM 预测的证据。评估将预测质量、特定基准的净效用以及固定决策规则下的回顾性投注回报和风险分开。在 324 场比赛的 28 个模型脚手架配置中，配对测试发现，经过多次测试修正后，有 7 次修正增益和 2 次修正增益。然而，在上限凯利结算下，每种配置的平均利润均为负值。在四种模型的比较中，可重用程序工作流程具有更高的平均投注利润和更低的研究费用，尽管这两个工作流程平均都会亏损。进一步的诊断表明，平均概率偏差在选定的赌注上发生逆转，并且盈利的单次运行可能取决于集中回报。这些发现促使在评估重复事件预测代理��分别评估预测能力、适应能力、资源使用和决策价值。
items.authors: Zhongwei Xie, Xingsu Li, Jingqiao Yu, Zihao Wang, Hong ChiTat, Zhaowei Wang, Weizhi Du, Yuxuan Liu, Huihao Jing, Jiaxin Bai, Yangqiu Song

items.title: PaperFormalizer: Author-in-the-Loop Autoformalization of Research Papers in Lean
items.title_zh: PaperFormalizer：精益研究论文的作者在环自动形式化
items.description: Even a carefully proofread paper can leave small gaps in its proofs or its stated assumptions. We introduce PaperFormalizer, a Lean-based agentic pipeline that helps authors find and close such gaps in their own papers and turn each paper into a Lean-verified version. Starting from the LaTeX source, PaperFormalizer transcribes the paper into a dependency graph of statements, audits each statement in natural language for faithfulness, ambiguity and correctness, and then formalizes and proves the statements in Lean against Mathlib, optional domain libraries and the author's personal toolkit. Only the author knows what a statement is meant to say and how a formalization gap in a result is best fixed. The pipeline therefore stops and asks the author whenever a statement admits more than one reading, presents every repair, in natural language and TeX symbols, as a proposal that the author can accept, decline or redirect, and leaves to the author every decision that could potentially change what the paper claims. The output is an annotated and revised version of the paper, a report of the changes, and Lean code in which each declaration is linked to the statement it formalizes. The author's toolkit grows as more papers are formalized, and authors can share their verified papers so that researchers who build on them can reuse their Lean code. By making verified papers practical to produce, PaperFormalizer aims to make research that rests on mathematical proofs more robust. PaperFormalizer runs inside a coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) and is available at https://github.com/Jiyuan-Tan/PaperFormalizer. Papers with Lean code shared by users are available at https://paperformalizer.org.
items.description_zh: 即使是经过仔细校对的论文也可能在其证明或陈述的假设中留下微小的空白。我们引入了 PaperFormalizer，这是一种基于精益的代理管道，可以帮助作者找到并弥补自己论文中的此类差距，并将每篇论文转变为经过精益验证的版本。从 LaTeX 源开始，PaperFormalizer 将论文转录成语句的依赖图，审核自然语言中的每个语句的真实性、歧义性和正确性，然后针对 Mathlib、可选域库和作者个人工具包在 Lean 中形式化和证明这些语句。只有作者知道陈述的含义以及如何最好地解决��果中的形式化差距。因此，每当一个声明承认多个阅读时，管道就会停止并询问作者，以自然语言和 TeX 符号呈现每一个修复，作为作者可以接受、拒绝或重定向的建议，并将可能改变论文主张的每一个决定留给作者。输出是带注释和修订的论文版本、变更报告以及精益代码，其中每个声明都链接到它形式化的声明。随着更多论文的形式化，作者的工具包也在不断增长，作者可以分享他们经过验证的论文，以便基于这些论文的研究人员可以重用他们的精益代码。通过使经过验证的论文变得切实可行，PaperFormalizer 旨在使基于数学证明的研究更加稳健。 PaperFormalizer 在编码代理（Claude Code 或 Codex）内运行，可从 https://github.com/Jiyuan-Tan/PaperFormalizer 获取。用户共享的包含精益代码的论文可在 https://paperformalizer.org 上找到。
items.authors: Jiyuan Tan, Vasilis Syrgkanis, Jose Blanchet

items.title: Speculative Diffusion is a Tale of Two Tradeoffs
items.title_zh: 投机扩散是两个权衡的故事
items.description: Speculative decoding is a technique that accelerates the inference speed of autoregressive large language models (LLMs) by sampling from a faster, lower quality draft model. Traditionally, a fundamental characteristic of speculative decoding is that it is lossless with respect to the verifier distribution, guaranteeing speed without sacrificing quality. This differs from recently developed diffusion LLMs (dLLMs), which are notably able to achieve substantial speedups by degrading the quality of their outputs with less diffusion effort. Because diffusion models are able to sample faster than autoregressive models by generating tokens in parallel, they are considered strong candidates for draft models in speculative diffusion. While it is widely understood that diffusion models can sacrifice quality for speed, speculative decoding itself can also be generalized to generate lossy samples faster using more lenient acceptance criteria with respect to the verifier distribution. Presented with the two parameters of diffusion effort and speculative decoding leniency, this paper explores the full achievable Pareto frontier via joint variations of these parameters. Our experiments show that jointly varying diffusion effort and acceptance leniency can extend the speed-quality Pareto frontier over single step diffusion drafting.
items.description_zh: 推测解码是一种通过从速度更快、质量较低的草稿模型中进行采样来加速自回归大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理速度的技术。传统上，推测解码的一个基本特征是它对于验证者分布是无损的，保证速度而不牺牲质量。这与最近开发的扩散LLM (dLLM) 不同，后者能够以较少的扩散工作降低输出质量，从而实现大幅加速。由于扩散模型能够通过并行生成标记来比自回归模型更快地采样，因此它们被认为是投机扩散中草案模型的有力候选者。虽然人们普遍认为扩散模型会为了速度而牺牲质量，但推测性解码本身也可以推广到使用相对于验证者分布更宽松的接受标准更快地生成有损样本。本文提出了扩散努力和推测解码宽大两个参数，通过这些参数的联合变化探索完全可实现的帕累托前沿。我们的实验表明，联合改变扩散努力和接受宽容可以扩展单步扩散起草的速度质量帕累托前沿。
items.authors: Aaron Zorel, Guy Van den Broeck, Aditya Grover, Daniel Israel

items.title: What Git Does Not Record: Provenance Legibility in Two AI-Assisted Research Repositories
items.title_zh: Git 不记录的内容：两个人工智能辅助研究存储库中的来源易读性
items.description: Publishers and funders increasingly ask authors to disclose how AI tools contributed to a piece of research. In computational work the repository is where an author or an auditor would look for the answer, and we ask what it can actually supply. We audit two single-investigator repositories by the same author in the same field, each carrying a different class of agent residue: a prescriptive trace of standing rule files and a narrative trace of a running agent scratchpad, in repositories of 466 and 103 commits. The two are legible in opposite ways. 85.6% of the lines ever committed to the prescriptive trace are visible at the current revision, and a standing rule states a conclusion and discards the episode behind it; the narrative trace records episodes and shows 21.8%. Counted by revision the gap is far smaller: 15 of the prescriptive trace's 41 revisions leave no visible line, against 18 of the narrative trace's 41. The Co-Authored-By trailer, the field an automated audit reads, is one of three AI trailer keys Project A carries and covers 66 of the 121 commits carrying any. In Project B it has low sensitivity against an explicit within-repository proxy: 39 commits revise a file maintained to hold an agent's working notes and 1 (2.6%) carries the trailer. Project A's repository-level rate is unstable in time too, stepping from 2.7% to 17.7% across a boundary we did not specify in advance. Repository channels disagree, and neither rate can be read as an involvement rate; we do not isolate the cause, and say so. We give a field-by-field account of which provenance claims such traces support, which they cannot, and which they answer confidently and wrongly, construct an auditable evidence ledger, and derive the requirements this places on any system meant to record research provenance as it happens.
items.description_zh: 出版商和资助者越来越多地要求作者披露人工智能工具如何为一项研究做出贡献。在计算工作中，存储库是作者或审计员寻找答案的地方，我们询问它实际上可以提供什么。我们审计了同一作者在同一领域的两个单研究者存储库，每个存储库都携带不同类别的代理残留：常设规则文件的规定性跟踪和正在运行的代理草稿本的叙述性跟踪，在 466 和 103 次提交的存储库中。两者以相反的方式可读。 85.6% 曾经致力于规定性痕迹的行���当前修订中是可见的，并且常设规则陈述了一个结论并丢弃了其背后的情节；叙事痕迹记录了情节并显示21.8%。按修订来计算，差距要小得多：规范跟踪的 41 个修订中有 15 个没有留下明显的线条，而叙述跟踪的 41 个修订中有 18 个没有留下明显的线条。自动审核读取的字段“共同创作者”预告片是项目 A 携带的三个 AI 预告片密钥之一，涵盖了携带任何密钥的 121 个提交中的 66 个。在项目 B 中，它对显式存储库内代理的敏感性较低：39 次提交修改了保存代理工作笔记的文件，1 次 (2.6%) 携带了预告片。项目 A 的存储库级别速率也随着时间的推移而不稳定，从 2.7% 跃升至 17.7%，跨越了我们事先未指定的边界。存储库渠道不一致，并且这两个比率都不能被解读为参与率；我们不会孤立原因，并这么说。我们逐个领域地说明哪些出处声称有这样的痕迹支持，哪些出处不能支持，哪些他们自信地和错误地回答，构建一个可审计的证据分类账，并得出这对任何旨在记录研究出处的系统的要求。
items.authors: Koutian Wu, Zesen Huang, Hejia Geng

items.title: FocusVLA: Future-Intent Guided Dynamic View Routing for Vision-Language-Action Models
items.title_zh: FocusVLA：视觉-语言-动作模型的未来意图引导动态视图路由
items.description: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have become an important paradigm for robotic manipulation by unifying visual perception, language understanding, and action generation. Since reliable manipulation requires sufficient observation of objects, end-effectors, and their spatial relationships, multi-view inputs are widely used to provide complementary spatial information. However, our experiments show that existing VLA models do not fully exploit such multi-view complementarity. The policy tends to persistently rely on the wrist view, lacking the ability to dynamically adjust global-local view dependency across manipulation stages, which limits stage adaptability and robustness. To address this issue, we propose FocusVLA, a stage-aware multi-view routing framework. FocusVLA predicts future interaction intent from historical actions and uses it to guide dynamic view routing during action generation. By adaptively coordinating global and local observations across different task stages, FocusVLA improves multi-view utilization. On RoboTwin 2.0, FocusVLA improves the average success rate over the strongest baseline π_{0.5} by 10.10 pp. In real-world evaluation, FocusVLA improves the success rate from 71.7\% to 85.0\%, achieving a 13.3\% gain over π_{0.5}. Moreover, the intent prediction and dynamic routing modules of FocusVLA can be integrated into existing VLA frameworks without modifying their core architectures.
items.description_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过统一视觉感知、语言理解和动作生成，已成为机器人操作的重要范例。由于可靠的操纵需要对物体、末端执行器及其空间关系进行充分观察，因此多视图输入被广泛用于提供互补的空间信息。然而，我们的实验表明，现有的 VLA 模型并没有充分利用这种多视图互补性。该策略往往持续依赖于手腕视图，缺乏跨操作阶段动态调整全局局部视图依赖性的能力，这限制了阶段的适应性和鲁棒性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 FocusVLA，一个阶段感知的多视图路由框架。 FocusVLA 从历史操作中预测未来的交互意图，并用它来指导操作生成期间的动态视图路由。通过自适应协调不同任务阶段的全局和局部观察，FocusVLA 提高了多视图利用率。在 RoboTwin 2.0 上，FocusVLA 将最强基线 π_{0.5} 的平均成功率提高了 10.10 个百分点。在实际评估中，FocusVLA 将成功率从 71.7% 提高到 85.0%，比 π_{0.5} 提高了 13.3%。此外，FocusVLA的意图预测和动态路由模块可以集成到现有的VLA框架中，而无需修改其核心架构。
items.authors: Huixin Xu, Ziya Yu, Peng Li

items.title: Does LeWorldModel Preserve Local Action Geometry?
items.title_zh: LeWorldModel 是否保留局部动作几何形状？
items.description: We examine how closely pretrained LeWorldModel (LeWM) reproduces the effects of small action changes. Using matched simulator and model responses, we measure action sensitivity with Gram matrices at three perturbation scales. Across nearly a thousand states from Reacher and OGBench Cube, the most sensitive action directions differ by median angles of about 36^circ and 42^circ, respectively, at the smallest scale. Increasing the perturbation tenfold reduces median normalized Gram discrepancy by roughly 70\% on Reacher and 47\% on Cube. Geometry measured in pixels and embeddings varies more across scales than the chosen physical-state geometry. On held-out directions, environment Grams achieve median embedding response errors of 17\% and 28\%, compared with 26\% and 38\% for an isotropic reference with the same trace. LeWM's errors are higher at this scale. These findings support scale-specific evaluation of action sensitivity; its effect on control remains an open question.
items.description_zh: 我们检查预训练的 LeWorldModel (LeWM) 如何精确地再现微小动作变化的影响。使用匹配的模拟器和模型响应，我们用格拉姆矩阵在三个扰动尺度上测量动作敏感性。在 Reacher 和 OGBench Cube 的近千个状态中，最敏感的动作方向在最小尺度上分别相差约 36^circ 和 42^circ 的中位角。将扰动增加十倍可将 Reacher 上的中值归一化 Gram 差异减少约 70\%，在 Cube 上减少约 47\%。以像素和嵌入测量的几何形状在不同尺度上的变化比所选择的物理状态几何形状��大。在保留方向上，环境 Gram 实现的中值嵌入响应误差为 17\% 和 28\%，而具有相同迹线的各向同性参考的中值嵌入响应误差为 26\% 和 38\%。 LeWM 在此规模上的误差较高。这些发现支持对行动敏感性进行特定量表的评估；它对控制的影响仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。

items.title: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video
items.title_zh: 通过视频阅读、写作、分享、与世界互动
items.description: Video foundation models have advanced rapidly in understanding and generating visual sequences, while video world models seek to capture the underlying dynamics of the world they depict. Despite their different objectives, both concern the relationship between video observations and an evolving world. This survey adopts world modeling as a unifying lens for examining these developments. Viewing an observed video as a partial, lossy, and temporally ordered projection of a latent temporal world, we organize the literature around four complementary operations: reading infers world properties from observed video; writing synthesizes video from specified or learned world conditions; sharing integrates understanding and generation through common modeling mechanisms; and interacting predicts and updates world states under actions and evolving observations. This perspective distinguishes temporal coherence in observed or generated sequences from consistency in the underlying world state. Across tasks, representations, models, datasets, and benchmarks, we trace a shift in emphasis from clip-level recognition and perceptual fidelity toward persistent state, controllable evolution, physical and causal validity, and evaluation grounded in interaction and downstream decisions, and we distill the open challenges that follow.
items.description_zh: 视频基础模型在理解和生成视觉序列方面取得了快速进展，而视频世界模型则试图捕捉它们所描绘的世界的潜在动态。尽管目标不同，但都关注视频观察与不断发展的世界之间的关系。这项调查采用世界模型作为检查这些发展的统一镜头。将观察到的视频视为潜在时间世界的部分、有损和时间顺序投影，我们围绕四个互补的操作组织文献：读取从观察到的视频推断世界属性；写作��据指定或已知的世界条件合成视频；共享通过通用建模机制整合理解和生成；并相互作用根据行动和不断变化的观察来预测和更新世界状态。这种观点将观察到的或生成的序列中的时间一致性与底层世界状态的一致性区分开来。在任务、表示、模型、数据集和基准中，我们追踪了从剪辑级识别和感知保真度到持久状态、可控进化、物理和因果有效性以及基于交互和下游决策的评估的重点转变，并提炼了随之而来的开放挑战。
items.authors: Shengqiong Wu, Meng Luo, Bobo Li, Ziwei Liu, Shuicheng Yan, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Philip Torr, Hao Fei
